synthesis.demographic_skew: The Maribyrnong demand visible in the records comes from self-directed, price-anchored buyers who source the hardware themselves and want install-only labour — one Maribyrnong VIC Airtasker post is 'Help me set up smart door lock (aqara u100) $400', a Oneflare Maribyrnong job states 'The lock is already purchased and ready to go' and 'Please bring your own tools' — and they schedule around work, with one Maribyrnong request 'Available anytime Friday, Sat or Sunday' and a deadline of 'Sunday 17th if possible'.
